title: April 2025: Lifelike AI voices, download grades, and improved admin moderation!
summary: Flint can now speak in over 200 dialects. Plus, teachers can now easily download grades from the platform.
body_markdown:
School administrators can now set guidelines for the AI to follow in its responses to inappropriate messages sent by students. This can include specific contact info for the AI to share with the student is a message referencing self harm is detected.


To read more updates about Flint, check out our[press](https://flintk12.com/) page.
